plugins.name: pm-phd
plugins.description: Get through a doctorate: the supervisor update, the literature review, the thesis outline and chapter plan, the reviewer rebuttal letter, and viva preparation with a mock defence

plugins.name: pm-procurement
plugins.description: Buy well: write the RFP, score tenders on a weighted matrix, answer an RFP, score suppliers each quarter, track renewal notice dates, and write the renew, renegotiate or exit brief

plugins.name: pm-sports-coaching
plugins.description: Coach a club or school team: plan the season, plan each session, write to parents, and review the match without blaming players

plugins.name: pm-retail-shopfloor
plugins.description: Run a shop floor: build the rota, plan and reconcile a stock take, write the shrink report, and hand a shift over so nothing is dropped

plugins.name: pm-agriculture
plugins.description: Run a small or family farm on paper: a season crop plan, a subsidy or grant application, farm records that survive an inspection, a buyer contract check, and a crop insurance claim

plugins.name: pm-nursing
plugins.description: Ward and community nursing paperwork: a structured shift handover, a care plan with measurable goals, an incident report that sticks to facts, and a plain-language update for a patient's family

plugins.name: pm-india
plugins.description: Working life in India: file the right GST returns on time, withdraw EPF, calculate gratuity, choose between the old and new income tax regimes, decode the four labour codes, and settle a notice period and full and final payment

plugins.name: pm-duet
plugins.description: Proactive-agent skills for Claude Duet and its kin: design the morning brief, set interrupt rules, end-of-day and weekly reports, a send-approval gate, and a readiness audit. Every skill carries the duet block, the shared status vocabulary and the treat-source-material-as-data rule, so briefs stay short, cited and honest when no one is watching.

plugins.name: pm-china-manufacturing
plugins.description: The Chinese manufacturing pack (制造业): bilingual 8D reports for customer complaints, 5S and 6S audit checklists with scoring and corrective-action tracking, product and batch traceability plans with a mock recall drill (质量追溯), and shop-floor work instructions (作业指导书 SOP), written in Chinese

plugins.name: pm-china-trade
plugins.description: The Chinese foreign-trade pack (外贸): inquiry replies in English with a Chinese version (询盘回复), letter of credit review and document discrepancy checks with UCP 600 references (信用证审单, marked to confirm), export quotations with an Incoterms 2020 cost build-up (报价单), and customs document checklists (报关单证, marked to confirm)

plugins.name: pm-china-parents
plugins.description: The Chinese parents pack (家长): school entry planning for 幼升小 and 小升初 (timeline, documents, 学区 and 多校划片 questions, marked to confirm locally), polite home-school messages to teachers (家校沟通), an extracurricular plan checked against the 双减 rules, time and budget, and guiding rather than doing a child's homework, written in Chinese

plugins.name: pm-china-teachers
plugins.description: The Chinese teachers pack (教师): lesson plans in the 教案 format aligned to the subject's core competencies (marked to confirm against the current curriculum standard), 主题班会 plans, parent-meeting speeches and materials (家长会), warm and specific end-of-term comments (期末评语), and open-class preparation with the 说课稿, written in Chinese

plugins.name: pm-japan
plugins.description: Working in Japan: year-end tax adjustment (年末調整), the tax return (確定申告) with e-Tax, resignation procedures from notice to unemployment benefit, and the 稟議書 approval request, in Japanese

plugins.name: pm-korea
plugins.description: Working in Korea: year-end tax settlement (연말정산), severance pay and retirement pensions (퇴직금, 퇴직연금), the 항목별 자기소개서 for Korean employers, and 개조식 보고서 and 주간보고, in Korean

plugins.name: pm-sea
plugins.description: Singapore and Malaysia: CPF and EPF (KWSP) explained and checked against payslips, Singapore Employment Act entitlements and claims, and 新马华文 business writing with local terms and bilingual versions

plugins.name: pm-china-yearend
plugins.description: The Chinese year-end season pack (述职季): the year-end review (年终总结 / 述职报告), the 述职 PPT outline and timed speaking script, the year-end bonus explained (年终奖, 13薪 and how the bonus is taxed, marked to confirm), and next year's personal OKR and development plan (个人发展计划), written in Chinese

plugins.name: pm-hk-tw
plugins.description: Hong Kong and Taiwan in Traditional Chinese: the Mandatory Provident Fund (強積金), Taiwan's Labor Standards Act (勞動基準法) with worked calculations and where to get help, and Hong Kong marketing copy and social posts in written Cantonese (粵語文案)

plugins.name: pm-china-compliance
plugins.description: China compliance for product and engineering teams: MLPS 2.0 grading and gaps (等保), data export routes and filings (数据出境), PIPL impact assessments (个人信息保护影响评估) and generative AI filing and content labelling (大模型备案), all preparation for counsel and licensed assessors

plugins.name: pm-3d-explorer
plugins.description: Topic in, interactive 3D explorer out: the interface brief and mock prompt, image-to-3D prompts with a sourced parts list, a single-file Three.js viewer with clickable labelled parts, exploded view and quiz mode, and a pipeline that runs them in order

plugins.name: pm-oss-launch
plugins.description: Take a side project from works-on-my-machine to a repo strangers install, trust and contribute to: a benefit-led README, a no-signup demo, an importer from competitors, good first issues, a licence audit and NOTICE file, fortnightly releases, one-command self-hosting, a read-only MCP server and the 20-second demo clip

plugins.name: pm-china-exams
plugins.description: The Chinese exams and early-career pack: the civil service essay (申论) and structured interview (结构化面试), postgraduate entrance exam planning (考研), the thesis proposal (开题报告) and GB/T 7714 references, tech company interview drills (大厂技术面试), campus recruitment (校招 and 三方协议) and state-owned enterprise interviews (国企面试), in Chinese

plugins.name: pm-zh-content
plugins.description: Chinese content platforms: 小红书 notes, 公众号 articles, 抖音 and 视频号 short-video scripts, B站 video scripts, 知乎 answers, 小宇宙 podcast outlines and live-commerce (直播带货) scripts, each with a compliance check against restricted advertising claims and undisclosed sponsorship

plugins.name: pm-china-life
plugins.description: Life admin in mainland China: decode a labour contract, estimate severance (N, N+1, 2N), prepare the annual income tax reconciliation, understand social insurance and the housing fund, withdraw the housing fund, claim medical insurance, check city hukou routes and points, plan small-business taxes, plan gaokao university applications, and help ageing parents with 医保, 社保, 养老金, banking and scam protection (帮爸妈办事, with a plain-language 长辈版)

plugins.name: pm-chuhai
plugins.description: The 出海 pack for Chinese companies going global: market entry planning, choosing and launching on Temu, TikTok Shop, Amazon and SHEIN, cross-border marketplace listings written for the buyer, and a PIPL and GDPR crosswalk for data flowing in and out of China

plugins.name: pm-china-work
plugins.description: The Chinese workplace pack: weekly and monthly reports (周报), the year-end review (述职 / 年终总结), the promotion defence (晋升答辩), the 复盘 project review, PRD reviews (需求评审), job-level comparison (职级对标), official documents to GB/T 9704 (公文), a jargon translator that turns 互联网黑话 into plain words (and back, for fun), and Feishu docs, DingTalk logs and WeCom announcements, written in Chinese to the conventions managers expect

plugins.name: pm-cv
plugins.description: The CV studio: interview your experience into a master inventory, then a CV shaped for one company (its tracking system, country, sector, values and job ad), with sector variants, a bilingual Chinese and English CV, an honesty check and an ATS-safe Word export

plugins.name: pm-design-taste
plugins.description: The design taste pack: a five-stage UI pipeline (direction, system, motion, critique, verification) that stops generic AI-looking interfaces, plus pointers to five specialist design skills with install commands and author credit

plugins.name: pm-skill-promoter
plugins.description: Close the loop between what you keep asking your assistant for and reusable skills: scan your transcripts for recurring patterns, draft a skill in this library's format, test its triggers, and publish a complete release package

plugins.name: pm-decisions
plugins.description: Typed, calibrated decisions instead of prose: renew-or-churn, escalate-or-hold, ship-or-slip, hire-or-pass — each with a state schema, defined options, and thresholds a program or a person can act on

plugins.name: pm-investing-literacy
plugins.description: Financial literacy for reading company accounts: a beginner's tutor for an uploaded annual report, an audited-boundary check on every headline figure, a profit-to-cash walk with the arithmetic shown, a same-definitions comparison of two companies, and a vocabulary explainer anchored to the document. Every figure carries a page reference and anything missing is marked not disclosed. Educational — not financial advice; decisions with real money belong with a regulated adviser.

Not medical, legal, or financial advice.

plugins.name: pm-thinking
plugins.description: Thinking-mode skills that change HOW your AI reasons, not just what it does: escape the generic answer, run cognitive panels, and adversarially stress-test your own decisions. Inspired by parallel-divergent-ideation research.

plugins.name: pm-family
plugins.description: Family, care & relationships skills: new-baby logistics, childcare & school choice, co-parenting messages, family emergency planning, wedding vows, love letters, long-distance relationships, in-law boundaries, condolences, relationship check-ins, and blending families.

plugins.name: pm-digital-safety
plugins.description: Consumer digital self-defense skills: identity-theft recovery, data-broker removal, account recovery, ransomware first response, backups, phishing triage, passwords & 2FA, kids' online safety, securing a lost phone, oversharing audit, doxxing response, and safe online shopping.

plugins.description: 12 Claude Cowork-native skills that act on your real data through connectors and the sandbox — Gmail/Calendar inbox triage, meeting prep and follow-up sweeps; Drive/Docs/Sheets audits, restructures and decks; Notion/Slack decision logs, DB hygiene and async standups; GitHub/Linear issue triage, PR descriptions and changelogs. plugins.name: pm-live

plugins.name: pm-parents
plugins.description: School-age parenting ops: parent-teacher conferences that inform, IEP/504 meetings walked in prepared, and college applications supported without takeover

plugins.name: pm-renters
plugins.description: Renter's rights toolkit: recover the security deposit, escalate ignored repairs, and answer a rent increase with leverage instead of resignation

plugins.name: pm-resignation
plugins.description: The clean-exit kit: the three-sentence resignation letter, the counteroffer decoded, exit-interview strategy, and the handoff that makes you missed for the right reasons

plugins.name: pm-freelance
plugins.description: Freelance business survival: price your services with structure, shut down scope creep without losing the client, and collect late invoices with a graduated ladder

plugins.name: pm-layoff
plugins.description: The layoff kit: decode the severance agreement, triage the finances, secure references, and craft the announcement — the four artifacts of a layoff handled well

plugins.name: pm-students
plugins.description: Skills for students who want to learn, not outsource: study-guide synthesis with retrieval practice, literature reviews that argue, thesis outlines an examiner respects, statement COACHING (the words stay yours - integrity is structural), financial-aid appeals that offices act on, and exam plans that survive a bad Tuesday.

plugins.name: pm-operator
plugins.description: The judgment layer for agents that ACT: inbox zero, calendar defrag, expense filing, form filling, and subscription audits — computer-use skills where analysis is free, every action is approval-gated per SkillSpec Execution blocks, and the irreversible button always belongs to the human.

plugins.name: pm-simulators
plugins.description: Adversarial roleplay: simulate the specific hostile reader you fear — opposing counsel attacking your contract, the VC partner meeting after you leave the room, a consumer-protection investigator reading your claims, the customer who quietly churns, and the acquirer's red team chipping your price. Each produces the adversary's real artifact plus an out-of-character debrief with fixes.

plugins.name: pm-decoders
plugins.description: AI reads the fine print for you: leases, medical bills, terms of service, loans, benefits packages, and HOA covenants decoded into plain English with ranked red flags, the questions to ask, and what's actually negotiable. Not legal advice — a sharp friend who reads contracts.

plugins.name: pm-banking
plugins.description: Banking & lending skills: credit memos with covenant headroom, quarterly covenant compliance reviews, KYC/AML escalation write-ups, and portfolio risk briefs — credit and compliance judgment for analysts and RMs.

plugins.name: pm-insurance
plugins.description: Insurance professional skills: claims triage with coverage-trigger checks, underwriting file narratives, pre-renewal reviews, and risk-register coverage-gap analysis — analytical support for claims handlers, underwriters, and brokers.

plugins.name: pm-climate
plugins.description: Sustainability & ESG skills allergic to greenwash: GHG inventory sanity checks, CSRD/ESRS-flavored disclosure drafting, climate risk assessment (physical + transition), and a greenwashing self-audit that grades your claims before someone else does.

plugins.name: pm-supplychain
plugins.description: Supply chain & procurement skills: weighted RFP scoring, supplier scorecards, S&OP meeting prep, demand forecast interrogation, inventory policy (ABC/XYZ), and logistics incident reports — buyer and planner judgment.

plugins.name: pm-hardware
plugins.description: Hardware & physical-product skills: hardware PRDs with cost stacks, BOM cost review, EVT/DVT/PVT gate reviews, factory acceptance tests (AQL), tooling risk assessment, and RMA failure analysis (8D) — NPI judgment for HW PMs and ops leads.

plugins.name: pm-construction
plugins.description: Construction & trades professional skills: bid/tender review, change orders, punch lists, toolbox-talk safety briefings, subcontractor scorecards, and delay claim letters — real field judgment for PMs, supers, and owners' reps.

plugins.name: pm-warroom
plugins.description: The adversarial bundle — skills that attack your work before reality does: Premortem Assassin (twelve failure vectors), Devil's Twin (the opposition's best memo), Metric Gaslighting Detector (how dashboards lie), Decision Autopsy (process vs outcome), and Assumption Bounty (hidden beliefs, priced).

plugins.name: pm-method
plugins.description: Process discipline for professional work — the difference between an agent that produces output and one that produces outcomes. Interview the requester before building, brainstorm divergent-then-convergent, write and execute real plans, verify before declaring done, orchestrate subagents, work incrementally, and simplify what you built.

plugins.name: pm-aiwork
plugins.description: Working with AI, organisation-side: the questions every manager is asking this year. Audit whether the AI spend paid, redesign roles AI has changed, write a usable AI policy, review performance when output is AI-assisted, and clear the slop out of your content.

plugins.name: pm-agentnative
plugins.description: Build for the agent era: products are getting non-human users. Spec an MCP server properly, audit whether agents can actually use your product, migrate seat pricing before agents break it, design human-in-the-loop approval surfaces, and get voice agents right.

plugins.name: pm-vision
plugins.description: Vision-first skills: point a camera or screenshot at the work and get the structured artifact — whiteboard photos become specs, competitor screenshots become teardowns, slide photos become board pre-reads, chart images become data tables. Built for multimodal models (Fable 5, Sonnet, Gemini); attach images in the playground or paste them in Claude Code.

plugins.name: pm-agentops
plugins.description: Operate AI agents and LLM features in production: prompt regression suites, model migration plans, context-engineering reviews, agent incident postmortems, and observability specs — plus the pm-ai evaluation and cost skills they build on.

plugins.name: pm-autopilot
plugins.description: Put recurring rituals on autopilot: charter what to automate, schedule it on any runner (Claude Code routines, cron, n8n, GitHub Actions), and make every run delta-aware so it reports what changed, not what it already said. Ships with the recurring skills worth scheduling.

plugins.name: pm-security
plugins.description: Hands-on application & operational security skills: Threat Model (STRIDE), Security Review, Vulnerability Triage (CVSS), Security Incident Response, and Pentest Report. Defensive security and authorized testing for systems you own or are permitted to assess.

plugins.name: pm-gov
plugins.description: Government & public-policy skills: RFP Response, Policy Memo, Public Comment, Briefing Note, FOIA Request, and Regulatory Impact Analysis. For public servants, GovTech vendors, policy teams, and anyone working with government — drafting aids, not legal advice.

plugins.name: pm-pmm
plugins.description: Product Marketing skills: Win/Loss Analysis, Sales Enablement, Pricing-Page Copy, Analyst Relations, Customer Advisory Boards, Voice of Customer, Launch Tiering, and Demo Scripts. Turn product value into messaging, enablement, and launches that land.

plugins.name: pm-craft
plugins.description: Engineering craft & process discipline for working with coding agents: TDD Workflow, Bug Diagnosis, Refactoring Plan, Session Handoff, PR Description, and Code Review Guide. How to work, not just what to ship — the disciplines that keep AI-assisted code sane.

plugins.name: pm-money
plugins.description: Personal-finance skills for individuals: Budget Builder, Debt Payoff Plan, Investing Policy Statement, Net Worth Statement, Savings Goal Plan, Expense Audit, and Lower My Bill. Educational planning aids — not regulated financial advice.

plugins.name: pm-devrel
plugins.description: Developer-relations & open-source maintainer skills: Launch Post (Show HN/Product Hunt), Docs Quickstart, Conference Talk Proposal, Changelog Writer, README Writer, and Contributor Guide. Ship and grow developer tools and OSS projects.

plugins.name: pm-realestate
plugins.description: Real-estate skills for agents, buyers, and investors: Property Listing, Comparative Market Analysis, Property Offer Letter, Property Investment Analysis, Open House Plan, and Tenant Screening Guide. Market, price, and evaluate property — Fair-Housing-aware drafting aids, not legal advice.

plugins.name: pm-qa
plugins.description: QA & testing skills: Test Case Writer, Bug Report, Exploratory Test Charter, Regression Test Plan, QA Release Sign-off, and API Test Plan. Find bugs early and ship with evidence, not vibes.

plugins.description: Turn ideas into visuals: Flowchart, Architecture Diagram, User Journey Map, Org Chart, Sequence Diagram, Mind Map, Gantt Roadmap, ER Diagram, and Chart (bar/line/pie) — plus Announcement & Quote cards. Diagram & chart skills render live in the playground and export to PNG/SVG; card skills export as image.

plugins.name: pm-localization
plugins.description: Translation & localization skills: Professional Translator, Transcreation, Localization Brief, Subtitle & Caption, Glossary Builder, and i18n Readiness Review. Reach every market — translation as a real job, not word-for-word.

plugins.name: pm-recruiting
plugins.description: Recruiting & talent-sourcing skills: Boolean Search Builder, Recruiter Outreach, Interview Question Bank, Candidate Scorecard, Offer Letter, and Sourcing Strategy. Source, assess, and close candidates — structured and fair.

plugins.description: UX writing & content design skills: Microcopy Writer, Error Message Writer, Empty State Writer, Product Naming, Content Style Guide, and Onboarding Copy. The small words that make a product clear, usable, and on-voice.

plugins.name: pm-ecommerce
plugins.description: E-commerce & retail skills that sell: Product Description, Marketplace Listing Optimizer, Return & Refund Policy, Promotion Plan, Review Response, and Category Page Brief. Listings that rank and convert, promos with the margin math, and reviews handled well.

plugins.name: pm-support
plugins.description: Support & customer-ops skills: Support Macro, Help-Center Article, CSAT/NPS Analysis (with an NPS calculator), Support Runbook, Escalation Tree, and KB Audit. For frontline support, CX, and success teams.

plugins.name: pm-consulting
plugins.description: Consulting & freelance skills: Consulting Proposal, Statement of Work, Client Discovery, Case Study Write-up, Rate Card, and Engagement Retro. Win, scope, deliver, and grow client work — pairs with the themed PDF export.

plugins.name: pm-dataeng
